text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most of the major races of the Classic spring have come to an end.
And now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The time has come to see
just how freely and wildly Mejiro Palmer
has been able to let loose up until today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty, let's do this, Palmer-chin☆
Starting the countdown to the final verdict, here we gooo!!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
OK, bestie!
3, 2, 1!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyy, broke past 9,000 folllowersâââ

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy, ay-ayyy☆彡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Living freely and running freely, Mejiro Palmer gained over 9,000 fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Helios, thank you!
We did it, we totally pulled it off!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"My fans right now aren't just regular fans.
Because...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because they're the ones who supported me when I ran as I pleased,
when I wasn't putting on an act as a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... My hands are sweating so much!
These vibes are insane!
I didn't know I could get this excited!
choice_data_list: How did it feel doing whatever you wanted?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, freedom really is a wonderful thing.
Buuuut~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was super scary!
Because both success and failure are your own responsibility, and you might cause trouble for others because of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Making your own choices" was way heavier than I thought.
Like, isn't this insane? Isn't it tough?
...But isn't it also super fun?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I finally realized it. Ever since I was a kid,
I was just protecting myself by refusing to choose anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"‘I lack talent, so I won't do anything extra.’
Apparently, she based all her thinking around that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you can't do it well on your own, you'll never get stronger unless you swallow your pride and rely on the help of those around you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And yet, if you don't even do that and just smoothly coast through,
of course you're not going to look lively.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "If anything, right now I feel like I've gone back to being a little kid who can say whatever she wants!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I kinda want a do-over of my youth from here on!
Without comparing myself to anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, looking good, Loli-Palmer, looking good♪
Let's keep pulling those grade-schooler moves from here on out★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So, where is our first field trip going to be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, a field trip?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Races, races☆ Where should smol Palmer-chin
go to just run all carefree, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Target races...
There are all kinds in summer and autumn too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey yo, Trainer yo!
If ya wanna pick a race, ya gotta check this first, yo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A guidebook☆ If we're going on a field trip, wouldn't a sightseeing spot be way better? Wouldn't that be super hype?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after looking through the guidebook,
the candidates that came up were...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "The Hakodate Kinen. A GIII held in Hokkaido during the summer, huh?"
choice_data_list: Wouldn't this be an easy place to run around?
Wouldn't this be an easy place to run around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, compared to GⅠs or GⅡs,
the pressure is way lower.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, how about the three of us
go for a fresh start right here!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy-waaayyy★ Restart!
Vroom-vroom-vroom!! Hokkaido vroom-vroooom!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it, since Trainer's treating,
let's pile on the crab dishes big time, vroom-vroom-vrooom!♪
choice_data_list: Well, you can't catch crabs in the summer, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, letting them refresh during the summer in Hokkaido seems like a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A youth starting over from scratch. Having returned to being a free-spirited girl, Mejiro Palmer's new journey begins—
with the Hakodate Kinen.
